title: Three.js game director skill system for Codex & Claude Code
author: MajidManzarpour
selftext:
I built a Three.js game director skill system for Codex & Claude Code to help agents create more polished playable browser games. It guides gameplay loops, graphics, HUD/UI, debugging, QA, and optional Tripo/Gemini/ElevenLabs 3D/image/audio assets if you provide API keys.   
  
Playable demo links are in the repo: [https://github.com/majidmanzarpour/threejs-game-skills](https://github.com/majidmanzarpour/threejs-game-skills)

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: This looks pretty solid. But in every demo janky camera movement detracted from the gameplay, perhaps you need a skill addressing that?

replies.author: MajidManzarpour
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback! I'll work on improving the camera skill

comments.author: GlitteringJob9248
comments.body: damn this game is insane good job!!!

comments.author: Living_Advice_1225
comments.body: Is the demo built entirely off threeJS? Even the 3d models?

replies.author: MajidManzarpour
replies.body: The code is three.js, the 3D models were generated with Tripo API (via the skills)

replies.author: Living_Advice_1225
replies.body: Thanks, I haven't used any AI services for 3d model generation yet. Is this the best valued inyour opinion?

replies.author: MajidManzarpour
replies.body: Definitely has the best quality and value out of the ones I've tried. You can also pay as you go for API credits

replies.author: Prior-Meeting1645
replies.body: Whats that is it like meshy ai? But the ai choses the prompts and generates it in the game?

replies.author: MajidManzarpour
replies.body: Yep the AI writes the prompts via the skills, and calls the API to get the models

comments.author: reverendblueball
comments.body: I thoroughly enjoyed this demo. I love the visuals, the lighting, the color theory, and the vehicles have weight and move through space realistically. This is worth pursuing. Well done.

comments.author: crypticevincar
